lines.en: label christmastwo11:
scene wizardparty1
: Holy fucking shit. I will literally never understand why anyone would willingly have a child.
lines.zh: : 我操他妈的。我真的永远理解不了为什么会有人心甘情愿生孩子。

lines.en: : Like, I can kind of understand it with babies because some people just think they’re fucking cute or whatever.
lines.zh: : 就是说，如果是小婴儿我多少还能理解，因为有些人就是觉得他们他妈的很可爱什么的。

lines.en: scene wizardparty2
: But as soon as they’re old enough to like, think and shit, they’re just fucking exhausting.
lines.zh: : 但一旦他们大到了会、怎么说、会思考会拉屎的年纪，就他妈的只剩累人了。

lines.en: : Wow. You really got all of that from just hanging out in Chinami’s room for five minutes?
lines.zh: : 哇。你就只在 Chinami 的房间里待了五分钟，就悟出了这么多？

lines.en: : Five minutes? That really how long I was in there for? Felt like a fucking month.
lines.zh: : 五分钟？我在里面真的只待了那么久？感觉像他妈的过了一个月。

lines.en: : Ten max, but probs closer to five. How was the room? Everything look clean enough?
lines.zh: : 最多十分钟，不过大概更接近五分钟。房间怎么样？看起来够干净吗？

lines.en: scene wizardparty3
: You know you coulda just came with me to check, right? Not sure what the point of waitin’ around in the lobby was if you were just gonna come right back up here.
lines.zh: : 你知道你本来可以跟我一起上去看看的吧？要是你就打算马上回这儿来，那在大堂里干等着有什么意义。

lines.en: : I just wanted to make sure you found the place okay. I trust you enough to take my sister to a specific room all by yourself.
lines.zh: : 我只是想确认你能顺利找到地方。我信任你，敢让你一个人把我妹妹带到某个特定的房间去。

lines.en: : Well, I sure hope I didn’t just drop her off in some random one. Feel like it might be a little tougher to get her back than it was to drop her off.
lines.zh: : 嗯，但愿我没有把她随便丢进某个陌生的房间。感觉要把她弄回来可比把她送过去难多了。

lines.en: : Hm? Sorry, what was that? I thought I heard Sensei say my name just now and I stopped paying attention.
lines.zh: : 嗯？抱歉，你说什么？我刚才好像听到老师提到我的名字，然后就没在听了。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. Didn’t realize you were gonna be playing the “creepy stalker girlfriend” game again tonight. No wonder you fuckin’ ran back here as fast as you could.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。没意识到你今晚又要玩“变态跟踪狂女友”那一套。怪不得你他妈的以最快速度跑回来了。

lines.en: scene wizardparty4
: I don’t think you’re understanding how hard it is to run in this outfit. You should be more impressed.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你没意识到穿成这样跑起来有多难。你该更佩服我才对。

lines.en: : The only thing I’m impressed by is your ability to stay so fucking devoted to a dude who probably jerks it to pictures of you in the school bathroom.
lines.zh: : 我唯一佩服的，是你对一个大概会在学校厕所里对着你的照片打飞机的男人还能这么死心塌地。

lines.en: scene wizardparty5
: You really think so?!
lines.zh: : 你真这么觉得？！

lines.en: : Chika, that’s not a fucking compliment!
lines.zh: : Chika，那他妈的可不是夸奖！

lines.en: : You mean to tell me you wouldn’t feel a little flattered if somebody was jerking off to pictures of you in the school bathroom?
lines.zh: : 你是说，如果有人在学校厕所里对着你的照片打飞机，你一点都不会觉得受宠若惊？

lines.en: : No! I’d feel fuckin’ sketched out! That’s not a thing I want people to do!
lines.zh: : 不会！我他妈会觉得毛骨悚然！我可不希望有人干这种事！

lines.en: scene wizardparty6
: Yeah, well, you’re a prude and it’s time for you to accept that somebody is probably going to masturbate while thinking about you one day.
lines.zh: : 行吧，你这人就是太保守了，是时候接受这个事实了——总有一天会有人一边想着你一边自慰。

lines.en: : Assuming you stop shit talking everyone all the time, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是你别再一天到晚说所有人坏话。

lines.en: : Unless they’re into the whole hatefucking thing, which...honestly, I think is kinda hot.
lines.zh: : 除非他们就好“恨着恨着就上床”那一口，不过……说实话，我觉得那个还挺带感的。

lines.en: : What the absolute fuck is happening to you?
lines.zh: : 你他妈的到底怎么了？

lines.en: scene wizardparty7
: Love...
lines.zh: : 爱情……

lines.en: : Also, I’m not just mindlessly shit talking everybody anymore. I’ve been tryin’ to get better with that shit.
lines.zh: : 还有，我已经不是无脑喷所有人了。我一直在努力改掉这个毛病。

lines.en: : Like, I haven’t said anything to Futaba ever since I apologized to her.
lines.zh: : 比如，自从我跟 Futaba 道歉之后，我就再也没对她说什么。

lines.en: scene wizardparty8
: Wait, you haven’t said anything to her since then? Isn’t that kinda like, going backwards?
lines.zh: : 等等，从那以后你一句话都没跟她说过？这难道不是，怎么说，在倒退吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...no? The fuck are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 呃……不是？你他妈的在说什么？

lines.en: : I just figured you two might wind up getting a little closer after that. I’m sure Futaba would be open to like, hanging out or something.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得你们俩之后可能会走得近一点。我敢肯定 Futaba 会很乐意，怎么说，一起出去玩之类的。

lines.en: : Which would also mean you’d have more to do than just waiting around for me all the time.
lines.zh: : 那样你也就不至于整天只知道等我了。

lines.en: : I’m good. One teacher-obsessed friend is exhausting enough as-is. Besides, she’s got plenty of other people to be around all the time.
lines.zh: : 我挺好的。有一个“迷恋老师的朋友”就已经够累的了。再说，她身边本来就有一堆人。

lines.en: : I’m fine with being alone. I don’t like, thrive off of constant validation the same way you do or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我一个人待着就行。我可不像你那样，靠不断的认可才能活。

lines.en: : You really don’t get even a little bit lonely sometimes?
lines.zh: : 你真的有时候一点都不觉得孤单吗？

lines.en: : Dude, I’ve been basically alone my whole life. I’d feel fucking weird if I wasn’t alone.
lines.zh: : 姐们儿，我这辈子基本上都是一个人过的。要不是一个人，我反而会觉得他妈的怪。

lines.en: scene wizardparty9
: Your backstory always makes me so sad.
lines.zh: : 你的身世总是让我很心疼。

lines.en: : Why? It’s not like you’re living the princess life either.
lines.zh: : 为什么？你过得也不是什么公主生活啊。

lines.en: : We’re two [teenage]girls raising a little brat and trying to just keep shit afloat without losin’ your apartment or gettin’ her sick. We ain’t got time to fuckin’ feel sorry for each other.
lines.zh: : 我们就是两个 [teenage]女孩，养着一个小屁孩，拼命维持生活不垮掉、不失去公寓、不让她生病。我们可没时间他妈的自怨自艾。

lines.en: : Yeah...Yeah, I guess you’re right.
lines.zh: : 是啊……是啊，你说得对。

lines.en: : I wonder how Chinami’s doing with Tsubasa. I hope she’s not nervous being around new people.
lines.zh: : 我好奇 Chinami 和 Tsubasa 相处得怎么样。希望她在陌生人身边不会紧张。

lines.en: : She’s fuckin’ Chinami. I’m sure she’s fine.
lines.zh: : 她可是 Chinami 啊。我肯定她没事。

lines.en: : I really hope so...
lines.zh: : 我真希望如此……

lines.en: scene black
Meanwhile...
lines.zh: 与此同时……

lines.en: scene wizardparty10
: Bow before me, peasant! I am Tsukasa Tsukioka, of the esteemed Tsukioka Family!
lines.zh: : 在我面前跪下，庶民！我是 Tsukioka Tsukasa，出自尊贵的 Tsukioka 家族！

lines.en: : But I’m sure I don’t have to explain who the Tsukiokas are to you, do I? Our name is everywhere! On every building! Every park bench!
lines.zh: : 不过我想我不需要向你解释 Tsukioka 家是谁吧？我们的名字到处都是！每一栋楼上！每一张公园长椅上！

lines.en: : We own this city! You are nothing! And you answer to me now!
lines.zh: : 我们拥有这座城市！你什么都不是！从现在起，你要听命于我！

lines.en: : Tsukasa, please play nice. Chinami does not have to answer to you.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，好好玩。Chinami 不必听命于你。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know who the Tsukiokas are, but she doesn’t go outside very much, so that’s probably why.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道 Tsukioka 家是谁，不过她很少出门，所以大概是因为这个。

lines.en: scene wizardparty11
: What do you mean you don’t know who we are? I thought everyone knew who we were.
lines.zh: : 你说不知道我们是谁是什么意思？我以为所有人都知道我们。

lines.en: : Not Chinami! Chinami thinks you’re just another stranger!
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道！Chinami 觉得你只是又一个陌生人！

lines.en: : A...stranger?
lines.zh: : 陌……陌生人？

lines.en: scene wizardparty12
: Mother, do you hear this? The peasant girl doesn’t know who we are. Are we not famous among the lower class?
lines.zh: : 母亲，您听到了吗？这个庶民女孩不知道我们是谁。我们在下层阶级里不出名吗？

lines.en: : We’re not “famous” at all, dear. We’re privileged enough to live the life that we do, so it is up to us to not throw that back in the faces of those less fortunate.
lines.zh: : 我们根本算不上“出名”，亲爱的。我们只是有幸过上了现在的生活，所以不该拿这份幸运去甩在不如我们的人脸上。

lines.en: : There will always be people who don’t know us because we have never taken the time to get to know them.
lines.zh: : 总会有人不认识我们，因为我们从来没有花时间去认识他们。

lines.en: : Does Papa know about this? Because Papa told me that everyone loves the Tsukiokas and that we can have whatever we want whenever we want.
lines.zh: : 爸爸知道这件事吗？因为爸爸告诉我，所有人都爱 Tsukioka 家，我们想要什么什么时候都能拿到。

lines.en: : Chinami isn’t even allowed to go outside without asking first! If she becomes a Tsukioka, will she also be able to do anything she wants?
lines.zh: : Chinami 连出门都得先问过才行！如果她成了 Tsukioka 家的人，是不是也能想做什么就做什么？

lines.en: scene wizardparty13
: Aha! So you do wish to become my underling! I can not say I blame you, peasant. Especially since you are being forced to wear rags like those instead of lavish, expensive dresses!
lines.zh: : 啊哈！这么说你果然想成为我的手下！我不怪你，庶民。尤其是你居然被迫穿着那样的破布，而不是奢华昂贵的裙子！

lines.en: : Chinami loves her clothes, though. And they look much warmer than yours.
lines.zh: : 不过 Chinami 很喜欢她的衣服。而且看起来比你的暖和多了。

lines.en: scene wizardparty14
: Mother! How do I get her to stop speaking and listen to my speech? I’m trying to expand our empire, but she keeps saying words and ruining everything!
lines.zh: : 母亲！我要怎么才能让她闭嘴听我演讲？我在努力扩张我们的帝国，可她一直说话，把一切都搞砸了！

lines.en: : Our empire is large enough, dear. Not everyone has to be a part of it.
lines.zh: : 我们的帝国已经够大了，亲爱的。不是所有人都非得加入。

lines.en: : Is Chinami a Tsukioka yet? Is she allowed to eat peanuts? Because Chinami is allergic to peanuts and doesn’t want to be that way anymore.
lines.zh: : Chinami 现在是 Tsukioka 家的人了吗？她可以吃花生了吗？因为 Chinami 对花生过敏，不想再过敏了。

lines.en: : You can’t just decide to not be allergic to things anymore, dear. It doesn’t work that way no matter how much money you have.
lines.zh: : 你不能说不想过敏就不过敏了，亲爱的。不管你有多少钱，这事都不是这么运作的。

lines.en: : Chinami is saddened by this news.
lines.zh: : Chinami 听到这个消息很伤心。

lines.en: scene wizardparty15
: And why do you talk like that?! Do they not teach you proper grammar in public school?! Is that something only us “privileged” people know about?
lines.zh: : 还有你为什么那样说话？！公立学校不教你们正确的语法吗？！那是我们这些“特权阶层”才知道的东西吗？

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t go to school, so she has no idea. This is just the way she talks.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不上学，所以不知道。她就是这么说话的。

lines.en: : She is a successful business owner, though! And the top purveyor of giraffes and giraffe-related merchandise in all of Kumon-mi!
lines.zh: : 不过她是一位成功的企业家！还是整个 Kumon-mi 最大的长颈鹿及长颈鹿相关商品供应商！

lines.en: scene wizardparty16
: In all of Kumon-mi? That sounds very impressive.
lines.zh: : 整个 Kumon-mi？听起来很厉害啊。

lines.en: : It is! Chinami is reporting at least 50%% growth year over year!
lines.zh: : 是的！Chinami 报告称同比增长至少 50%%！

lines.en: : Mother! Has Papa penetrated the giraffe industry yet?
lines.zh: : 母亲！爸爸已经打入长颈鹿产业了吗？

lines.en: scene wizardparty17
: Your father hasn’t penetrated anything in quite a while, dear.
lines.zh: : 你父亲已经有相当一段时间什么都没“打入”了，亲爱的。

lines.en: : In fact, I’m beginning to think that he may have forgotten how.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我开始怀疑他可能已经忘了怎么“打入”了。

lines.en: : Lies! I bet Papa penetrates all types of things! In fact, I bet he’s penetrating giraffes at this very moment! He will not be out-penetrated by this petulant child!
lines.zh: : 谎言！我打赌爸爸什么都能“打入”！事实上，我打赌他此刻正在“打入”长颈鹿！他绝不会在这个任性的小孩面前甘拜下风！

lines.en: scene wizardparty18
: Tsukasa! Stop saying “penetrate” right this instant! It is making your mother very angry!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa！立刻停止说“打入”这两个字！你母亲非常生气！

lines.en: : Fine, Mother! I love you! Please forgive me!
lines.zh: : 好的，母亲！我爱你！请原谅我！

lines.en: scene wizardparty19
: Lord, grant me the strength I need to make it through the night....
lines.zh: : 主啊，请赐予我熬过今晚所需的力量……

lines.en: scene wizardparty20
: So...if you really are a successful business owner...what is your business called?
lines.zh: : 那么……如果你真的是一位成功的企业家……你的生意叫什么名字？

lines.en: : Chinami’s business is called Chinami-Corp! It stands for Chinami Corporation! And Chinami calls it that because it is a corporation that could not exist without Chinami.
lines.zh: : Chinami 的生意叫 Chinami-Corp！是 Chinami Corporation 的缩写！Chinami 之所以这么叫，是因为这是一家离了 Chinami 就无法存在的公司。

lines.en: scene wizardparty21
: Naming your first business after yourself? That sounds quite impressive, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 把自己的第一份生意以自己的名字命名？听起来相当了不起，Chinami。

lines.en: : But if you think for a second that I will allow you to continue dominating this...niche industry of giraffe ownership in Kumon-mi, you have another thing coming!
lines.zh: : 但如果你以为我会让你继续垄断 Kumon-mi 这个长颈鹿饲养的……细分产业，那你就大错特错了！

lines.en: scene wizardparty22
: You see, I’ve been meaning to start my own business as well, and it just so happens that I was planning on selling giraffes and...giraffe-related merchandise!
lines.zh: : 你看，我也一直打算创业，而且巧了，我正准备卖长颈鹿和……长颈鹿相关商品！

lines.en: : Your days are numbered, Chi-
lines.zh: : 你的日子不多了，Chi——

lines.en: : Chinami is excited to hear about future competition and wishes your business great success in the future!
lines.zh: : Chinami 很高兴听到未来会有竞争对手，并祝你的生意未来大获成功！

lines.en: scene wizardparty23
: What?! No! You’re supposed to fear me! My business is obviously going to be better! I have the financial backing of the Tsukioka foundation! We’re famous!
lines.zh: : 什么？！不！你应该害怕我才对！我的生意显然会更好！我有 Tsukioka 基金会的资金支持！我们很有名！

lines.en: : If Chinami doesn’t know you, you probably aren’t famous enough.
lines.zh: : 如果 Chinami 不认识你，那你大概还不够有名。

lines.en: : But...we are! We’re important! Just because you don’t know about us doesn’t mean we’re not!
lines.zh: : 可我们就是有名！我们很重要！你不知道我们，不代表我们不存在！

lines.en: scene wizardparty24
: Excuse me. Tsubasa? Can Chinami have some peanuts as a snack, please?
lines.zh: : 打扰一下。Tsubasa？Chinami 可以吃点花生当零食吗？

lines.en: : No, Chinami. Your secondary sister already warned me that you would try and pull something like this, and I already promised I wouldn’t let it happen.
lines.zh: : 不行，Chinami。你的“次席姐姐”早就警告过我你会来这一手，而我已经答应过她不会让它发生。

lines.en: : That was no sister of Chinami’s. That was an assassin sent by a government agency who plans to take down Chinami-Corp. Peanuts, please!
lines.zh: : 那才不是 Chinami 的姐姐。那是某个政府机构派来的刺客，企图搞垮 Chinami-Corp。请给我花生！

lines.en: : No, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 不行，Chinami。

lines.en: : Rats!
lines.zh: : 可恶！

lines.en: scene wizardparty25
: Chinami-Corp is...a prominent enough business that even the government is attempting to intervene? Are you sure it was an assassin, Chinami?
lines.zh: : Chinami-Corp 已经……显赫到连政府都试图干预了吗？你确定那是刺客吗，Chinami？

lines.en: : Maybe! Chinami’s memory gets foggy when she is hungry.
lines.zh: : 也许吧！Chinami 一饿，记忆就会变得模糊。

lines.en: : When she’s...
lines.zh: : 她一……

lines.en: scene wizardparty26
: Then we will have a Christmas feast!
lines.zh: : 那就让我们来一场圣诞盛宴吧！

lines.en: : Mother! Call the kitchen! Order two of everything on the menu! And tell them if they’re not here in ten minutes that they’re fired!
lines.zh: : 母亲！打电话给厨房！菜单上每样都来两份！告诉他们如果十分钟之内没送到，他们就被解雇了！

lines.en: : Tsukasa, please stop firing kitchen staff in every establishment we enter. There are only so many cooks left in the city.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，请别在我们进的每一家店里都解雇厨房员工。这座城市剩下的厨师已经不多了。

lines.en: : Chinami thinks a feast sounds fun!
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得盛宴听起来很有趣！

lines.en: scene wizardparty27
: But Chinami doesn’t have any money since she invests it all back into her company.
lines.zh: : 不过 Chinami 没有钱，因为她把钱都重新投进公司了。

lines.en: : Never fear, Chinami. Tsukasa has all of the money. And she’s interested in hearing more about how you run your business.
lines.zh: : 别怕，Chinami。Tsukasa 有的是钱。而且她有兴趣多了解你经营生意的方式。

lines.en: : I forgot to mention it, but Tsukasa has also been intending to find a business partner lately. And since Chinami is close to the same age as her, Tsukasa thinks she might be a good fit.
lines.zh: : 我忘了说，Tsukasa 最近也一直想找一个生意伙伴。既然 Chinami 和她年纪相仿，Tsukasa 觉得她或许是个合适的人选。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, dear, are you really going to start talking like that as well? Because I have no idea how I’m going to explain it to your father.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa，亲爱的，你真的也要开始这么说话了吗？因为我完全不知道该怎么跟你父亲解释。

lines.en: scene wizardparty28
: Silence, mother! This is just how the new age of entrepreneurs speaks!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，母亲！新时代的创业者就是这么说话的！

lines.en: : Does Chinami accept Tsukasa’s feast proposal? Chinami can consider it an investment for the future if so.
lines.zh: : Chinami 接受 Tsukasa 的盛宴提议吗？如果接受，Chinami 可以把它当作一笔对未来的投资。

lines.en: : Chinami accepts and is pleased to open business relations with you!
lines.zh: : Chinami 接受，并很高兴与你开启商业关系！

lines.en: : She was already very excited to meet another girl her age, but had no idea it would be such a successful venture!
lines.zh: : 她本来就已经很兴奋能认识一个同龄的女孩了，却没想到这会是如此成功的一场合作！

lines.en: scene wizardparty29
: Chinami...I think this is the beginning of a very beautiful friendship.
lines.zh: : Chinami……我觉得这是一段非常美好的友谊的开端。

lines.en: : Chinami is excited to finally have a friend and will try to forget that you hurt her feelings by calling her a peasant earlier.
lines.zh: : Chinami 很高兴终于有了一个朋友，也会努力忘掉你之前叫她庶民伤了她的心。

lines.en: : Textbook rival speak, Chinami. Sometimes, you need to psyche out your opponent before they even know they’re competing.
lines.zh: : 教科书级别的对手发言，Chinami。有时候，你得在对手还不知道自己在竞争之前就先瓦解他们的心理。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t care anymore. She just wants to eat.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不在乎了。她只想吃饭。

lines.en: : Mother! The feast!
lines.zh: : 母亲！盛宴！

lines.en: : I’m calling right now, dear...
lines.zh: : 我现在就打，亲爱的……

lines.en: scene black
scene wizardparty30
: Yeah...you’re probably right. I bet she's doing fine, but...
lines.zh: : 是啊……你大概是对的。我打赌她没事，不过……

lines.en: : But what?
lines.zh: : 不过什么？

lines.en: : Havin’ second thoughts about standing around and staring at our fuckin’ teacher all night?
lines.zh: : 开始后悔站在这儿整晚盯着我们他妈的老师看了？

lines.en: scene wizardparty31
: You know what? Maybe I should just run over there and check on her to make sure everything’s okay before...staring at our “fucking teacher” all night.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？也许我该直接跑过去看看她的情况，确认一切都好，然后再……整晚盯着我们“他妈的老师”看。

lines.en: : You wanna come with me?
lines.zh: : 你要跟我一起去吗？

lines.en: : Sure. But only cause the alternative is standing around here by myself and looking like a fucking wack job.
lines.zh: : 好。不过只是因为另一个选择是自己一个人站在这儿，看着像个他妈的神经病。

lines.en: scene wizardparty32
: True. But hey! At least you’d get a turn to watch Sensei flirt with the rest of the class instead of me!
lines.zh: : 说得也是。不过嘿！至少这次轮到你看着老师跟全班其他女生调情了，不用再是我！

lines.en: : Jesus, I can taste the salt from here.
lines.zh: : 天哪，隔着这么远我都能尝到酸味了。

lines.en: : What salt? I’m totally fine and not jealous at all!
lines.zh: : 什么酸味？我完全没事，一点都不嫉妒！

lines.en: : Mhm. And I’m a happily married housewife with three kids and a puppy.
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯。我还是个有三个孩子和一只小狗的幸福家庭主妇呢。

lines.en: : Let’s just fuckin’ get this over with.
lines.zh: : 我们他妈的赶紧把这事了结吧。
